rules.title: Optimizing for AI features
rules.rule: Foundational SEO still applies to AI search: make original useful content crawlable, maintain accurate business/product details and useful images/video. No special AI schema, AI text file or llms.txt is required; Google ignores llms.txt. Monitor Search Console including its documented generative AI performance reporting.
rules.limitations: Snapshot of public documentation; no outcome guarantee.

rules.title: Creating helpful reliable people-first content
rules.rule: Prioritize original information, firsthand expertise, clear sourcing and a satisfying answer for the intended audience.

rules.title: LocalBusiness structured data

rules.title: Organization structured data

rules.rule: Choose the business objective first, then campaign type, budget, bidding, assets and targeting.

rules.rule: Review actual spend and goal-aligned conversion performance before adjusting budget; check performance after changes.

rules.title: Choose your bid and budget
rules.rule: Start small and review daily. An average daily budget is not a hard daily cap; Google describes overdelivery and monthly limits. Select bidding for the intended outcome.
rules.limitations: Local day-by-day ledger is a planning envelope, not a Google billing limit or campaign setting.

rules.title: Instagram and Facebook Reels ads
rules.rule: Consider Advantage+ placements where appropriate; manual setups are advised to use six or more placements. Customize creative for native 9:16 Reels, audio and safe zones; use A/B tests to learn.

rules.title: R5 bounded allocation policy
rules.rule: Keep one paid channel and one objective. Hold 10% in reserve. Under $500 or $20/day avoid a separate retargeting slice; above both, allocate 10% only with user-reported usable audience and explicit retargeting request. Flag under $10/day as thin. Three angles, days 1/mid/end checks; no separate testing campaign.
rules.limitations: Conservative product choices, not platform minimums, optimized allocation, statistical power or predicted results.
